II. THE MINIMAL GAUGED U (1)B−LMODEL WITH Z₂ PARITY

The model is based on the gauge group SU (3)C× SU (2)L× U (1)Y× U (1)B−L. Additional fields besides the standard model fields are a gauge field Zµ ′ of the U (1)B−L, a SM singlet B−L Higgs boson Ψ with two U (1)B−Lcharge, and three RH neutrinos Niwhich are necessary for the gauge and gravitational anomaly cancellations.
